verses.original: כָּרַ֥ע בֵּל֙ קֹרֵ֣ס נְב֔וֹ הָיוּ֙ עֲצַבֵּיהֶ֔ם לַחַיָּ֖ה וְלַבְּהֵמָ֑ה נְשֻׂאֹתֵיכֶ֣ם עֲמוּס֔וֹת מַשָּׂ֖א לַעֲיֵפָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kā·ra‘ bêl qō·rês nə·ḇōw hā·yū ‘ă·ṣab·bê·hem la·ḥay·yāh wə·lab·bə·hê·māh nə·śu·’ō·ṯê·ḵem ‘ă·mū·sō·wṯ maś·śā la·‘ă·yê·p̄āh
verses.literal: Bel crouches Nebo . . . cowers Their idols weigh down beasts and cattle The images you carry are burdensome a load to the weary animal
verses.literalPt: BEL está abatido, Nebo se encurvou, os seus ídolos são postos sobre os animais e sobre as feras; as cargas dos vossos fardos são canseiras para as feras já cansadas.

verses.original: קָרְס֤וּ כָֽרְעוּ֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו לֹ֥א יָכְל֖וּ מַלֵּ֣ט מַשָּׂ֑א וְנַפְשָׁ֖ם בַּשְּׁבִ֥י הָלָֽכָה׃ס
verses.transliteration: qā·rə·sū ḵā·rə·‘ū yaḥ·dāw lō yā·ḵə·lū mal·lêṭ maś·śā wə·nap̄·šām baš·šə·ḇî hā·lā·ḵāh
verses.literal: The gods cower they crouch together unable to relieve the burden but they themselves go into captivity
verses.literalPt: Juntamente se encurvaram e se abateram; não puderam livrar-se da carga, mas a sua alma entrou em cativeiro.

verses.original: שִׁמְע֤וּ אֵלַי֙ בֵּ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְכָל־ שְׁאֵרִ֖ית בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הַֽעֲמֻסִים֙ מִנִּי־ בֶ֔טֶן הַנְּשֻׂאִ֖ים מִנִּי־ רָֽחַם׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū ’ê·lay bêṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·ḵāl šə·’ê·rîṯ bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl ha·‘ă·mu·sîm min·nî- ḇe·ṭen han·nə·śu·’îm min·nî- rā·ḥam
verses.literal: Listen to Me O house of Jacob all the remnant of the house of Israel who have been sustained from the womb carried along since birth
verses.literalPt: Ouvi-me, ó casa de Jacó, e todo o restante da casa de Israel; vós a quem trouxe nos braços desde o ventre, e sois levados desde a madre.

verses.original: וְעַד־ זִקְנָה֙ אֲנִ֣י ה֔וּא וְעַד־ שֵיבָ֖ה אֲנִ֣י אֶסְבֹּ֑ל אֲנִ֤י עָשִׂ֙יתִי֙ וַאֲנִ֣י אֶשָּׂ֔א וַאֲנִ֥י אֶסְבֹּ֖ל וַאֲמַלֵּֽט׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘aḏ- ziq·nāh ’ă·nî hū wə·‘aḏ- šē·ḇå̄h ’ă·nî ’es·bōl ’ă·nî ‘ā·śî·ṯî wa·’ă·nî ’eś·śā wa·’ă·nî ’es·bōl wa·’ă·mal·lêṭ
verses.literal: Even to your old age I will be the same and I will bear you up when you turn gray I have made you and I will carry you I will sustain you and deliver you
verses.literalPt: E até à velhice eu serei o mesmo, e ainda até às cãs eu vos carregarei; eu vos fiz, e eu vos levarei, e eu vos trarei, e vos livrarei.

verses.literal: To whom will you liken Me or count Me equal To whom will you compare Me that we should be alike
verses.literalPt: A quem me assemelhareis, e com quem me igualareis, e me comparareis, para que sejamos semelhantes?

verses.original: הַזָּלִ֤ים זָהָב֙ מִכִּ֔יס וְכֶ֖סֶף בַּקָּנֶ֣ה יִשְׁקֹ֑לוּ יִשְׂכְּר֤וּ צוֹרֵף֙ וְיַעֲשֵׂ֣הוּ אֵ֔ל יִסְגְּד֖וּ אַף־ יִֽשְׁתַּחֲוּֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: haz·zā·lîm zā·hāḇ mik·kîs wə·ḵe·sep̄ baq·qā·neh yiš·qō·lū yiś·kə·rū ṣō·w·rêp̄ wə·ya·‘ă·śê·hū ’êl yis·gə·ḏū ’ap̄- yiš·ta·ḥăw·wū
verses.literal: They pour out their bags of gold and weigh out silver on scales they hire a goldsmith to fashion it into a god so they can bow down and worship
verses.literalPt: Gastam o ouro da bolsa, e pesam a prata nas balanças; assalariam o ourives, e ele faz um deus, e diante dele se prostram e se inclinam.

verses.original: יִ֠שָּׂאֻהוּ עַל־ כָּתֵ֨ף יִסְבְּלֻ֜הוּ וְיַנִּיחֻ֤הוּ תַחְתָּיו֙ וְיַֽעֲמֹ֔ד מִמְּקוֹמ֖וֹ לֹ֣א יָמִ֑ישׁ אַף־ יִצְעַ֤ק אֵלָיו֙ וְלֹ֣א יַעֲנֶ֔ה מִצָּרָת֖וֹ לֹ֥א יוֹשִׁיעֶֽנּוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: yiś·śā·’u·hū ‘al- kā·ṯêp̄ yis·bə·lu·hū wə·yan·nî·ḥu·hū ṯaḥ·tāw wə·ya·‘ă·mōḏ mim·mə·qō·w·mōw lō yā·mîš ’ap̄- yiṣ·‘aq ’ê·lāw wə·lō ya·‘ă·neh miṣ·ṣā·rā·ṯōw lō yō·wō·šî·‘en·nū
verses.literal: They lift it to their shoulder and carry it along they set it in its place and there it stands not budging from that spot They cry out to it but it does not answer it saves no one from his troubles
verses.literalPt: Sobre os ombros o tomam, o levam, e o põem no seu lugar; ali fica em pé, do seu lugar não se move; e, se alguém clama a ele, resposta nenhuma dá, nem livra alguém da sua tribulação.

verses.original: זִכְרוּ־ זֹ֖את וְהִתְאֹשָׁ֑שׁוּ הָשִׁ֥יבוּ פוֹשְׁעִ֖ים עַל־ לֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ziḵ·rū- zōṯ wə·hiṯ·’ō·šā·šū hā·šî·ḇū p̄ō·wō·šə·‘îm ‘al- lêḇ
verses.literal: Remember this and be brave take it to heart you transgressors
verses.literalPt: Lembrai-vos disto, e considerai; trazei-o à memória, ó prevaricadores.

verses.original: זִכְר֥וּ רִאשֹׁנ֖וֹת מֵעוֹלָ֑ם כִּ֣י אָנֹכִ֥י אֵל֙ וְאֵ֣ין ע֔וֹד אֱלֹהִ֖ים וְאֶ֥פֶס כָּמֽוֹנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ziḵ·rū ri·šō·nō·wṯ mê·‘ō·w·lām kî ’ā·nō·ḵî ’êl wə·’ên ‘ō·wḏ ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·’e·p̄es kā·mō·w·nî
verses.literal: Remember what happened long ago for I am God and there is no other I am God and there is none like Me
verses.literalPt: Lembrai-vos das coisas passadas desde a antiguidade; que eu sou Deus, e não há outro Deus, não há outro semelhante a mim.

verses.original: מַגִּ֤יד מֵֽרֵאשִׁית֙ אַחֲרִ֔ית וּמִקֶּ֖דֶם אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־ נַעֲשׂ֑וּ אֹמֵר֙ עֲצָתִ֣י תָק֔וּם וְכָל־ חֶפְצִ֖י אֶעֱשֶֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: mag·gîḏ mê·rê·šîṯ ’a·ḥă·rîṯ ū·miq·qe·ḏem ’ă·šer lō- na·‘ă·śū ’ō·mêr ‘ă·ṣā·ṯî ṯā·qūm wə·ḵāl ḥep̄·ṣî ’e·‘ĕ·śeh
verses.literal: I declare the end from the beginning and from ancient times what is still to come I say My purpose will stand and all My good pleasure I will accomplish
verses.literalPt: Que anuncio o fim desde o princípio, e desde a antiguidade as coisas que ainda não sucederam; que digo: O meu conselho será firme, e farei toda a minha vontade.

verses.original: קֹרֵ֤א מִמִּזְרָח֙ עַ֔יִט מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מֶרְחָ֖ק אִ֣ישׁ עֲצָתוֹ אַף־ דִּבַּ֙רְתִּי֙ אַף־ אֲבִיאֶ֔נָּה יָצַ֖רְתִּי אַף־ אֶעֱשֶֽׂנָּה׃ס
verses.transliteration: qō·rê mim·miz·rāḥ ‘a·yiṭ mê·’e·reṣ mer·ḥāq ’îš ʿă·ṣå̄·ṯō ’ap̄- dib·bar·tî ’ap̄- ’ă·ḇî·’en·nāh yā·ṣar·tî ’ap̄- ’e·‘ĕ·śen·nāh
verses.literal: I summon a bird of prey from the east a man for My purpose from a far-off land Truly I have spoken and truly I will bring it to pass I have planned it and I will surely do it
verses.literalPt: Que chamo a ave de rapina desde o oriente, e de uma terra remota o homem do meu conselho; porque assim o disse, e assim o farei vir; eu o formei, e também o farei.

verses.original: שִׁמְע֥וּ אֵלַ֖י אַבִּ֣ירֵי לֵ֑ב הָרְחוֹקִ֖ים מִצְּדָקָֽה׃
verses.literal: Listen to Me you stubborn people far removed from righteousness
verses.literalPt: Ouvi-me, ó duros de coração, os que estais longe da justiça.

verses.original: קֵרַ֤בְתִּי צִדְקָתִי֙ לֹ֣א תִרְחָ֔ק וּתְשׁוּעָתִ֖י לֹ֣א תְאַחֵ֑ר וְנָתַתִּ֤י בְצִיּוֹן֙ תְּשׁוּעָ֔ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תִּפְאַרְתִּֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: qê·raḇ·tî ṣiḏ·qā·ṯî lō ṯir·ḥāq ū·ṯə·šū·‘ā·ṯî lō ṯə·’a·ḥêr wə·nā·ṯat·tî ḇə·ṣî·yō·wn tə·šū·‘āh lə·yiś·rā·’êl tip̄·’ar·tî
verses.literal: I am bringing My righteousness near it is not far away and My salvation will not be delayed I will grant salvation to Zion and adorn Israel with My splendor
verses.literalPt: Faço chegar a minha justiça, e não estará ao longe, e a minha salvação não tardará; mas estabelecerei em Sião a salvação, e em Israel a minha glória.
